🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT 🎃
Help Bramble the Witch, treat spooky monster patients, trick-or-treat around the practice and spend your candy on exclusive Halloween furniture, scrubs and the Flying Mop! 🧹🍬

🌸 Welcome to Lakefalls Medical: GP Simulator! 🩺

Experience realistic primary care role-play in a busy community medical practice, created by a UK doctor!

• 🩺 Assess patients & run interactive examinations
• 💊 Diagnose, prescribe & treat minor illnesses
• ❤️ Complete health reviews & preventative care
• 🚨 Handle emergencies
• 🏥 Decide whether patients can go home or need hospital care
• 👨‍⚕️ Roleplay as a Nurse, GP, Receptionist, Manager or Patient
• 🎨 Claim & customise your room for FREE!

Enjoying the game? Leave a 👍 and ⭐ to support future updates!

🏷️: Roleplay, Medical, Healthcare, GP, Primary Care, Doctor, Nurse, Clinic, Community Care, Simulation
